BiblicalUsage: Moses pleads for Israel: remember thy servants Abraham, Isaac and Jacob, and look not unto the stubbornness of this people. The word is the obstinacy itself, named once, in a prayer.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Moses' prayer is the right one: look not at our stubbornness, but at thy servants and thy promise.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
